about: Place names for the GPS-tagged portfolio photos, resolved once so the location card can name a place without a network lookup. Keys are latitude,longitude rounded to three decimals (InspectorCore.placeKey). Photos not listed here fall back to a single cached reverse lookup in the visitor's browser (see InspectorMap.js).
source: OpenStreetMap: protected-area boundaries (Overpass is_in) and town or county names (Nominatim reverse, zoom 14). Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
